Unhein is tarah namuraad karna yeh goya pesh-e-khaima tha Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki be'sat ka aur ittila thi aap ki aamad-aamad ki. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isi saal tawallud huye, aksar tareekh-daan hazraat ka yahi qaul hai. Toh goya Rabb-ul-Aalameen farma raha hai ke aye Quraishiyo! Habsha ke is lashkar par tumhein fatah tumhari bhalayi ki wajah se nahin di gayi thi balkay is mein hamaray ghar ka bachaao tha jisay hum sharaf, buzurgi, azmat-o-izzat mein apnay Aakhir-uz-Zaman paighambar Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat se barhanay walay thay. Gharz Ashab-e-Feel ka mukhtasar waqea toh yeh hai jo bayan hua aur mutawwal waqea Ashab-e-Ukhdood ke bayan mein guzar chuka hai ke qabeela Humair ka aakhri badshah Zunawas jo mushrik tha jis ne apnay zamane ke musalmanon ko khayiyon mein qatl kiya tha jo sachay Nasrani thay aur tadaad mein taqreeban bees hazar thay, saaray ke saaray shaheed kar diye gaye thay sirf Daus Zu-Tha'laban ek bach gaya tha jo mulk-e-Shaam ja pohancha aur Qaisar-e-Room se faryad-rasi chahi. Yeh badshah Nasrani mazhab par tha, us ne Habsha ke badshah Najashi ko likha ke is ke saath apni poori fauj kar do is liye ke yahan se dushman ka mulk qareeb tha. Us badshah ne Arbaat aur Abu Yaksoom Abraha bin Sabah ko ameer-e-lashkar bana kar bahut bara lashkar de kar dono ko is ki sarkobi ke liye rawana kiya. Yeh lashkar Yaman pohancha aur Yaman ko aur Yamaniyon ko takht-o-taraj kar diya. Zunawas bhaag khara hua aur darya mein doob kar mar gaya aur un logon ki saltanat ka khatma ho gaya aur saaray Yaman par Shah-e-Habsha ka qabza ho gaya aur yeh dono sardar yahan rehnay sehnay lagay lekin kuch thori muddat ke baad un mein na-chaqi ho gayi. Aakhir naubat yahan tak pohanchi ke dono ne aamnay saamnay safein baandh lein aur larnay ke liye nikal aaye. Aam hamla honay se beshtar un dono sardaron ne aapas mein kaha ke faujon ko laranay aur logon ko qatl karanay ki kya zaroorat, aao hum tum dono maidan mein niklein aur ek dusray se lar kar faisla kar lein jo zinda bach jaye mulk-o-fauj us ki. Chunancha yeh baat tay ho gayi aur dono maidan mein nikal aaye. Arbaat ne Abraha par hamla kiya aur talwar ke ek hi waar se chehra khoon-o-khoon kar diya, naak, hont aur munh kat gaya. Abraha ke ghulam Atwada ne is mauqa par Arbaat par ek be-panah hamla kiya aur usay qatl kar diya. Abraha zakhmi ho kar maidan se zinda wapas gaya. Ilaaj-e-mualija se zakhm achay ho gaye aur Yaman ka yeh mustaqil badshah ban baitha.

Najashi Habsha ko jab yeh waqia maloom hua toh woh sakht gussa hua aur ek khat Abraha ko likha, usay bari lanat-malamat ki aur kaha ke qasam Allah ki main tere shehron ko pamal kar doonga aur teri choti kaat laoon ga. Abraha ne is ka jawab nihayat aajizi se likha aur qasid ko bohat saaray hadiye diye aur ek thaili mein Yaman ki mitti bhar di aur apni peshani ke baal kaat kar is mein rakh diye. Aur apne khat mein apne qasooron ki maafi talab ki aur likha ke yeh Yaman ki mitti hazir hai aur choti ke baal bhi, aap apni qasam poori kijiye aur narazgi maaf farmaiye. Is se Shah-e-Habsha khush ho gaya aur yahan ki sardari isi ke naam kar di. Ab Abraha ne Najashi ko likha ke main yahan Yaman mein aap ke liye ek aisa girja tameer kar raha hoon ke ab tak duniya mein aisa na bana ho aur is girja ghar ka banana shuru kiya baray ehtimam aur karr-o-farr se, bohat ooncha, bohat mazboot, behad khubsurat aur munaqqash-o-muzayyan girja banaya. Is qadar buland tha ke choti tak nazar daalne wale ki topi gir padti thi, isi liye Arab isay Qalees kehte yani topi phenk dene wala. Ab Abraha Ashram ko yeh soojhi ke log bajaye Ka'batullah ke hajj ke is ka hajj karein, apni saari mamlikat mein is ki munadi kara di. Adnaniya aur Qahtaniya Arab ko yeh bohat bura laga, udhar se Quraish bhi bharak uthay. Thore din mein koi shakhs raat ke waqt is ke andar ghus gaya aur wahan pakhana karke chala aaya. Chowkidar ne jab yeh dekha toh badshah ko khabar pohanchai aur kaha ke yeh kaam Quraishiyon ka hai, chunke aap ne un ka Ka'ba rok diya hai lehaza unhon ne josh aur ghazab mein aa kar yeh harkat ki hai. Abraha ne usi waqt qasam kha li ke main Makkah pohanchoon ga aur Baitullah ki eent se eent baja doonga. Aur ek riwayat mein yun bhi hai ke chand milay julay naujawan Quraishiyon ne is girja mein aag laga di thi aur us waqt hawa bhi bohat tez thi, saara girja jal gaya aur munh ke bal zameen par gir gaya. Is par Abraha ne bohat bada lashkar saath le kar Makkah par charhai ki taake koi rok na sake aur apne saath ek bada ooncha aur mota hathi liya jisay Mahmood kaha jata tha.

Is jaisa hathi aur koi na tha. Shah-e-Habsha ne yeh hathi us ke paas isi garz se bheja tha. Aath ya barah hathi aur bhi sath thay. Yeh Ka'bay ke dhane ki niyat se chala, yeh soch kar ke Ka'bay ki deewaron mein mazboot zanjeerein daal doon ga aur hathiyon ki gardanon mein un zanjeeron ko baandh doon ga. Hathi ek hi jhatkay mein charon deewarein Baitullah ki jar se gira dein ge. Jab Ahl-e-Arab ko yeh khabrein maloom huin to un par bada bhari asar hua. Unhon ne musammam irada kar liya ke khwah kuch bhi ho hum zaroor is se muqabla karenge aur usay is ki is badkirdari se roken ge. Ek Yamani shareef sardar jo wahan ke badshahon ki aulad mein se tha jisay Zunafar kaha jata tha, yeh khada ho gaya, apni qoum ko aur kul aas paas ke Arab ko jama kiya aur is badniyat badshah se muqabla kiya, lekin qudrat ko kuch aur hi manzoor tha. Arabon ko shikast hui aur Zunafar is khabeeth ke hath mein qaid ho gaya. Us ne usay bhi sath liya aur Makkah Shareef ki taraf badha. Khath'am qabeelay ki zameen par jab yeh pohancha to yahan Nafeel bin Habeeb Khath'ami ne apne lashkaron se is ka muqabla kiya lekin Abraha ne unhein bhi maghloob kar liya aur Nafeel bhi qaid ho gaya. Pehle to is zalim ne usay qatl karna chaha lekin phir qatl na kiya aur qaid karke sath le liya taake rasta banaye. Jab Taif ke qareeb pohancha to qabeela Saqeef ne is se sulah kar li ke aisa na ho un ke but-khanon ko jis mein Laat nami but tha yeh tod de. Us ne bhi un ki badi aao-bhagat ki. Unhon ne Abu Righal ko is ke sath kar diya ke yeh tumhein wahan ka rasta bataye ga. Abraha jab Makkah ke bilkul qareeb Mu'ammis ke pohancha to us ne yahan padao kiya. Is ke lashkar ne aas paas Makkah walon ke jo janwar oont waghera char chug rahe thay sab ko apne qabzay mein kiya. In janwaron mein do sau oont to sirf Abdul Muttalib ke thay. Aswad bin Maqsood jo is ke lashkar ke harawal ka sardar tha, us ne Abraha ke hukum se in janwaron ko loota tha, jis par Arab shairon ne is ki hajo mein ashaar tasneef kiye hue hain jo Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein mojood hain. Ab Abraha ne apna qasid Hanata Hameeri Makkah walon ke paas bheja ke Makkah ke sab se bade sardar ko mere paas lao aur yeh bhi elaan kardo ke main Makkah walon se ladne nahin aaya, mera irada sirf Baitullah ko girane ka hai. Haan agar Makkah wale is ke bachane ke darpay hue to la-mahalah mujhe un se ladai karni padegi. Hanata jab Makkah mein aaya aur logon se mila jula to maloom hua ke yahan ka bada sardar Abdul Muttalib bin Hashim hai. Yeh Abdul Muttalib se mila aur shahi paigham pohanchaya jis ke jawab mein Abdul Muttalib ne kaha: Wallah na hamara irada is se ladne ka hai na hum mein itni taqat hai. Yeh Allah ka hurmat wala ghar hai, is ke Khaleel Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki zinda yaadgar hai. Allah agar chahe ga to apne ghar ki aap hifazat kare ga, warna hum mein to himmat-o-quwwat nahin.

Hanata ne kaha achha toh aap mere saath badshah ke paas chale chaliye. Abdul Muttalib saath hue, badshah ne jab unhein dekha toh haibat mein aa gaya. Abdul Muttalib gore chitte, sadol aur mazboot qawi wale haseen-o-jameel insaan thay, dekhte hi Abraha takht se neeche utar aaya aur farsh par Abdul Muttalib ke saath baith gaya aur apne tarjuman se kaha ki in se pooch ki kya chahta hai? Abdul Muttalib ne kaha mere do sau oont jo badshah ne le liye hain unhein wapas kar diya jaye. Badshah ne kaha in se keh de ki pehli nazar mein tera raub mujh par pada tha aur mere dil mein teri waqat baith gayi thi lekin pehle hi kalam mein tu ne sab kuch kho diya, apne do sau oont ki toh tujhe fikr hai aur apne aur apni qaum ke deen ki tujhe fikr nahin, main toh tum logon ka ibadat khana todne aur use khaak mein milane ke liye aaya hoon. Abdul Muttalib ne jawab diya ki sun badshah, oont toh mere hain is liye unhein bachane ki koshish mein main hoon aur Khana-e-Kaaba Allah ka hai, woh khud use bacha lega. Is par yeh sarkash kehne laga ki Allah bhi aaj use mere haath se nahin bacha sakta. Abdul Muttalib ne kaha behtar hai, woh jaane aur tu jaane. Yeh bhi marwi hai ki Makka ne tamam Hijaz ka tihai maal Abraha ko dena chaha ki woh apne is bad-irada se baaz aaye lekin us ne qabool na kiya. Khair, Abdul Muttalib toh apne oont lekar chal diye aur aakar Quraish ko hukum diya ki Makka bilkul khaali kar do, pahadon mein chale jao. Ab Abdul Muttalib apne saath Quraish ke chida-chida logon ko lekar Baitullah mein aaya aur Baitullah ke darwaze ka kunda thaam kar ro-ro kar aur gidgida-gidgida kar duayein maangni shuru keen ki Bari Ta'ala Abraha aur us ke khoon-khwar lashkar se apne paak aur zi-izzat ghar ko bacha le. Abdul Muttalib ne us waqt yeh duaiya ashaar padhe:

La humma innal mar'a yamna'u rahlahu famna' rihalak, la yaghlibanna salibuhum wa mahaluhum abadan mahalaka.

Ya'ni hum be-fikr hain, hum jaante hain ki har ghar wala apne ghar ka bachao aap karta hai, aye Allah! Tu bhi apne ghar ko apne dushmanon se bacha, yeh toh hargiz nahin ho sakta ki un ki saleeb aur un ki dolen teri dolon par ghalib aa jayein.

Ab Abdul Muttalib ne Baitullah ke darwaze ka kunda haath se chhor diya aur apne tamam sathiyon ko lekar aas paas ke paharon ki chotiyon par charh gaya. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke jaate hue qurbani ke sau oont Baitullah ke ird-gird nishan lagakar chhor diye the is niyat se ke agar yeh baddin aaye aur unhon ne Allah ke naam ki qurbani ke in janwaron ko chhera to azab-e-Ilahi un par utrega. Dusri subah Abraha ke lashkar mein Makkah jaane ki tayariyan hone lagin, apna khaas hathi jis ka naam Mahmood tha use tayar kiya, lashkar mein kamar-bandi ho chuki thi aur Makkah Sharif ki taraf munh utha kar chalne ki tayari ki. Is waqt Nafeel bin Habeeb jo us se raaste mein lara tha aur ab bator-e-qaidi ke us ke saath tha, woh aage barha aur shahi hathi ka kaan pakar liya aur kaha, "Mahmood baith ja aur jahan se aaya hai wahin khairiyat ke saath chala ja, tu Allah Ta'ala ke mohtaram shehar mein hai." Yeh keh kar kaan chhor diya aur bhaag kar qareeb ki pahari mein ja chupa. Mahmood hathi yeh sunte hi baith gaya, ab hazar jatan feelban kar rahe hain, lashkari bhi koshishein karte karte thak gaye lekin hathi apni jagah se hilta hi nahin, sar par ankush maar rahe hain, idhar udhar se bhale aur barchhe maar rahe hain, aankhon mein ankush daal rahe hain, garz tamam jatan kar liye lekin hathi jumbish bhi nahin karta. Phir bator-e-imtehan ke us ka munh Yaman ki taraf karke chalana chaha to jhat se khara ho kar dorta hua chal diya, Shaam ki taraf chalana chaha to bhi poori taqat se aage barh gaya, mashriq ki taraf le jana chaha to bhi bhaga bhaga gaya, phir Makkah Sharif ki taraf munh karke aage barhana chaha wahin baith gaya. Unhon ne phir use marna shuru kiya, dekha ke ek ghata-top parindon ka jhurmat badal ki tarah samundar ke kinare ki taraf se umda chala aa raha hai, abhi poori tarah dekh bhi nahin paye the ke woh janwar sar par aa gaye, charon taraf se saare lashkar ko gher liya aur un mein har ek ki chonch mein ek masar ya maash ke daane barabar kankari thi, aur dono panjon mein do do kankariyan thin. Yeh un par phenkne lage, jis par yeh kankari aan pari woh wahin halak ho gaya. Ab to is lashkar mein bhagdar par gayi, har ek Nafeel Nafeel karne laga kyunke use un logon ne apna rahbar aur raaste batane wala samajh rakha tha. Nafeel to hathi ko keh kar pahar par charh gaya aur deegar ahl-e-Makkah un logon ki yeh durgat apni aankhon se dekh rahe the aur Nafeel wahin khara yeh ashaar parh raha tha.

Ainal mafarr-u wal-ilahut-talib, wal-ashramul maghloob laisal ghalib. Ab jaye panah kahan hai? Jabke Allah khud taak mein lag gaya hai. Suno ashram badbakht maghloob ho gaya, ab yeh panapne ka nahin. Aur bhi Nufail ne is waqiye ke mutaliq bahut se ashaar kahe hain jin mein is waqiye ko bayan kiya hai aur kaha hai: Kash ke tu us waqt maujood hota jabke in hathi walon ki shamat aayi hai aur wadi-e-muhassab mein in par azab ke sangreze barse hain, to us waqt tu is Allah ke lashkar yani parindon ko dekh kar qatan sajde mein gir padta. Hum to wahan khade hamd-e-Rabb ki ragniyan alap rahe the, go kaleje hamare bhi unche ho gaye the ke kahin koi kankari hamara kaam bhi tamam na kar de. Nasrani munh mode bhag rahe the aur Nufail Nufail pukar rahe the. Goya ke Nufail par unke baap dadon ka koi qarz tha. Waqidi farmate hain yeh parinde zard rang ke the, kabootar se kuch chhote the, unke paon surkh the. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Mahmood hathi baith gaya aur puri koshish ke bawajood bhi na utha to unhon ne dusre hathi ko aage kiya, usne qadam badhaya hi tha ke uski peshani par kankari padi aur bilbila kar peeche hata aur phir aur hathi bhi bhag khade hue. Idhar barabar kankariyan aane lagin, aksar to wahin dher ho gaye aur baaz jo idhar udhar bhag nikle, un mein se koi jaanbar na hua. Bhagte bhagte unke aaza kat kar girte jate the aur bilakhir jaan se jate the. Abraha badshah bhi bhaga lekin ek ek uzw-e-badan jharna shuru hua, yahan tak ke Khusam ke shahron mein se Sana mein jab woh pahuncha to bilkul gosht ka lothra bana hua tha, wahin bilak bilak kar dam toda aur kutte ki maut mara, dil tak phat gaya. Quraishiyon ko bada maal hath laga, Abdul Muttalib ne to sone se ek kunwan pur kar liya tha. Zameen-e-Arab mein aabla aur chechak isi saal paida hote hue dekhe gaye aur isi tarah sapand aur hanzal waghera ke kadwe darakht bhi isi saal zameen-e-Arab mein dekhe gaye hain. Pas Allah Ta'ala bazuban-e-Rasool-e-Masoom (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni yeh nemat yaad dilata hai aur goya farmaya ja raha hai ke agar tum mere ghar ki isi tarah izzat-o-hurmat karte rehte aur mere Rasool ko mante to main bhi isi tarah tumhari hifazat karta aur tumhein dushmanon se nijat deta. Ababeel jama ka seegha hai, iska wahid lughat-e-Arab mein paya nahin gaya. Sijjeel ke ma'ani hain bahut hi sakht aur baaz mufassireen kehte hain ke yeh do Farsi lafzon se murakkab hai yani sang aur gil se, yani mitti aur patthar. Garz Sijjeel woh hai jis mein patthar ma'a mitti ke ho. Asf jama hai asfat ki, kheti ke un patton ko kehte hain jo pak na gaye hon.

Ababeel ke ma'ani hain garoh garoh, jhund, bahut saare, pai dar pai, jama shuda, idhar udhar se aane wale. Ba'az nahvi kehte hain is ka wahid abeel hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain in parindon ki chonch thi parindon jaisi aur panje kutton jaise. Ikrama farmate hain yeh sabz rang ke parind thay jo samundar se nikle thay, in ke sar darindon jaise thay. Aur aqwal bhi hain, yeh parind baqaida in lashkariyon ke saron par paray baandh kar kharay ho gaye aur phir cheekhne lage, phir patthar phenka, jis ke sar mein laga us ke neeche se nikal gaya aur do tukray ho kar zameen par gira, jis jis uzw par gira woh uzw saaqit ho gaya. Saath hi tez aandhi aayi jis se aur aas paas ke kankar bhi in ki aankhon mein ghus gaye aur sab teh-o-bala ho gaye. 'Asf' kehte hain chaaray ko aur kati kheti ko aur gehun ke darakht ke patton ko, aur 'ma'kool' se murad tukray tukray kiya hua hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke 'asf' kehte hain bhoosi ko jo anaaj ke daanon ke oopar hoti hai. Ibn Zaid farmate hain murad kheton ke woh patte hain jinhein jaanwar char chuke hon. Matlab yeh hai ke Allah ne in ko tehas nehas kar diya aur aam-o-khaas ko halak kar diya, is ki saari tadbeerein ulat ho gayin, koi bhalai unhein naseeb na hui, aisa bhi koi un par sahih saalim na raha jo ke in ki khabar pahunchaye. Jo bhi bacha woh zakhmi ho kar aur us zakhm se phir jaan bar na ho saka. Khud baadshah bhi go woh ek gosht ke lothray ki tarah ho gaya tha, joon toon Sana mein pahuncha lekin wahan jaate hi us ka kaleja phat gaya aur waqia bayaan kar hi chuka tha ke mar gaya. Is ke baad is ka larka yaksu Yaman ka baadshah bana, phir is ke dusre bhai Masroq bin Abraha ko saltanat mili. Ab Seeb bin Dhu-Yazan Humairi Kisra ke darbar mein pahuncha aur us se madad talab ki taake woh ahl-e-Habsha se lare aur Yaman in se khaali kara le. Kisra ne is ke saath ek lashkar-e-jarrar kar diya, is lashkar ne ahl-e-Habsha ko shikast di aur Abraha ke khandan se saltanat nikal gayi aur phir qabila Humair yahan ka baadshah ban gaya. Arabon ne is par bari khushi manayi aur charon taraf se mubarakbadiyan wasool huin.

Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Abraha ke lashkar ke feelban aur charkatay ko main ne Makkah Sharif mein dekha, dono andhay ho gaye thay, chal phir nahin saktay thay aur bheek manga kartay thay. Hazrat Asma bint-e-Abi Bakr (R.A) farmati hain, Isaf aur Naila buton ke paas yeh baithay rehtay thay jahan mushrikeen apni qurbaniyan kartay thay aur logon se bheek mangtay phirtay thay. Is feelban ka naam Anisa tha. Ba'az tareekhon mein yeh bhi hai ke Abraha khwah is charhai mein na tha balkay us ne apne lashkar ko ba-mat-huti Shams bin Maqsood ke bheja tha. Yeh lashkar bees hazar ka tha aur yeh parind un ke oopar raat ke waqt aaye thay aur subh tak un sab ka satya-nas ho chuka tha, lekin yeh riwayat bohat ghareeb hai aur sahih baat yeh hai ke khud Abraha Ashram Habshi hi apne sath lashkar le kar aaya tha. Yeh mumkin hai ke us ke har-awal ke dastay par yeh shakhs sardar ho. Is waqiye ko bohat se Arab shairon ne apne sheron mein bhi bast ke sath bayan kiya hai. Surah Fath ki tafsir mein hum is waqiye ko mufassal bayan kar aaye hain, jis mein hai ke jab Hudaibiyah walay din Rasool Allah (ﷺ) us teelay par charhay jahan se aap Quraishiyon par janay walay thay to aap ki oontni baith gayi. Logon ne usay danta-dipta lekin woh na uthi. Log kehnay lagay Qaswa thak gayi, aap ne farmaya yeh thaki nahin, is mein urnay ki aadat hai, isay us Allah ne rok liya hai jis ne hathiyon ko rok liya tha. Phir farmaya us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, Makkah walay jin sharait par mujh se sulah chahein ge main sab maan loon ga bashart-e-ke Allah ki hurmaton ki hatak is mein na ho. Phir aap ne usay danta to woh foran uth khari hui. Yeh hadith Sahih Bukhari Muslim ki hai aur ek hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Makkah par se hathiyon ko rok liya aur apne Nabi ko wahan ka qabza diya aur apne imandar bandon ko, suno aaj is ki hurmat waisi hi laut kar aa gayi hai jaisay kal thi, khabardar har hazir ko chahiye ke ghair-hazir ko pohancha de. Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Feel ki tafsir khatam hui.

Abraha aur us ka hashr: Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat ne Quraish par jo apni khaas ne'mat inaam farmayi thi us ka zikr kar raha hai ke jis lashkar ne haathiyon ko saath le kar Ka'be ko dhane ke liye charhayi ki thi Allah Ta'ala ne us se pehle ke woh Ka'be ke wajood ko mitayein un ka naam-o-nishan mita diya. Un ki tamam fareb-kariyan, un ki tamam quwwatein salb kar lein, barbaad-o-gharat kar diya. Yeh log mazhaban Nasrani thay lekin deen-e-Masih ko maskh kar diya tha, qareeban but-parast ho gaye thay. Unhein is tarah namuraad karna yeh goya pesh-e-khaima tha Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki be'sat ka aur ittila thi aap ki aamad-aamad ki. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isi saal tawallud huye, aksar tareekh-daan hazraat ka yahi qaul hai. Toh goya Rabb-ul-Aalameen farma raha hai ke aye Quraishiyo! Habsha ke is lashkar par tumhein fatah tumhari bhalayi ki wajah se nahin di gayi thi balkay is mein hamaray ghar ka bachaao tha jisay hum sharaf, buzurgi, azmat-o-izzat mein apnay Aakhir-uz-Zaman paighambar Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat se barhanay walay thay. Gharz Ashab-e-Feel ka mukhtasar waqea toh yeh hai jo bayan hua aur mutawwal waqea Ashab-e-Ukhdood ke bayan mein guzar chuka hai ke qabeela Humair ka aakhri badshah Zunawas jo mushrik tha jis ne apnay zamane ke musalmanon ko khayiyon mein qatl kiya tha jo sachay Nasrani thay aur tadaad mein taqreeban bees hazar thay, saaray ke saaray shaheed kar diye gaye thay sirf Daus Zu-Tha'laban ek bach gaya tha jo mulk-e-Shaam ja pohancha aur Qaisar-e-Room se faryad-rasi chahi. Yeh badshah Nasrani mazhab par tha, us ne Habsha ke badshah Najashi ko likha ke is ke saath apni poori fauj kar do is liye ke yahan se dushman ka mulk qareeb tha. Us badshah ne Arbaat aur Abu Yaksoom Abraha bin Sabah ko ameer-e-lashkar bana kar bahut bara lashkar de kar dono ko is ki sarkobi ke liye rawana kiya. Yeh lashkar Yaman pohancha aur Yaman ko aur Yamaniyon ko takht-o-taraj kar diya. Zunawas bhaag khara hua aur darya mein doob kar mar gaya aur un logon ki saltanat ka khatma ho gaya aur saaray Yaman par Shah-e-Habsha ka qabza ho gaya aur yeh dono sardar yahan rehnay sehnay lagay lekin kuch thori muddat ke baad un mein na-chaqi ho gayi. Aakhir naubat yahan tak pohanchi ke dono ne aamnay saamnay safein baandh lein aur larnay ke liye nikal aaye. Aam hamla honay se beshtar un dono sardaron ne aapas mein kaha ke faujon ko laranay aur logon ko qatl karanay ki kya zaroorat, aao hum tum dono maidan mein niklein aur ek dusray se lar kar faisla kar lein jo zinda bach jaye mulk-o-fauj us ki. Chunancha yeh baat tay ho gayi aur dono maidan mein nikal aaye. Arbaat ne Abraha par hamla kiya aur talwar ke ek hi waar se chehra khoon-o-khoon kar diya, naak, hont aur munh kat gaya. Abraha ke ghulam Atwada ne is mauqa par Arbaat par ek be-panah hamla kiya aur usay qatl kar diya. Abraha zakhmi ho kar maidan se zinda wapas gaya. Ilaaj-e-mualija se zakhm achay ho gaye aur Yaman ka yeh mustaqil badshah ban baitha.

Najashi Habsha ko jab yeh waqia maloom hua toh woh sakht gussa hua aur ek khat Abraha ko likha, usay bari lanat-malamat ki aur kaha ke qasam Allah ki main tere shehron ko pamal kar doonga aur teri choti kaat laoon ga. Abraha ne is ka jawab nihayat aajizi se likha aur qasid ko bohat saaray hadiye diye aur ek thaili mein Yaman ki mitti bhar di aur apni peshani ke baal kaat kar is mein rakh diye. Aur apne khat mein apne qasooron ki maafi talab ki aur likha ke yeh Yaman ki mitti hazir hai aur choti ke baal bhi, aap apni qasam poori kijiye aur narazgi maaf farmaiye. Is se Shah-e-Habsha khush ho gaya aur yahan ki sardari isi ke naam kar di. Ab Abraha ne Najashi ko likha ke main yahan Yaman mein aap ke liye ek aisa girja tameer kar raha hoon ke ab tak duniya mein aisa na bana ho aur is girja ghar ka banana shuru kiya baray ehtimam aur karr-o-farr se, bohat ooncha, bohat mazboot, behad khubsurat aur munaqqash-o-muzayyan girja banaya. Is qadar buland tha ke choti tak nazar daalne wale ki topi gir padti thi, isi liye Arab isay Qalees kehte yani topi phenk dene wala. Ab Abraha Ashram ko yeh soojhi ke log bajaye Ka'batullah ke hajj ke is ka hajj karein, apni saari mamlikat mein is ki munadi kara di. Adnaniya aur Qahtaniya Arab ko yeh bohat bura laga, udhar se Quraish bhi bharak uthay. Thore din mein koi shakhs raat ke waqt is ke andar ghus gaya aur wahan pakhana karke chala aaya. Chowkidar ne jab yeh dekha toh badshah ko khabar pohanchai aur kaha ke yeh kaam Quraishiyon ka hai, chunke aap ne un ka Ka'ba rok diya hai lehaza unhon ne josh aur ghazab mein aa kar yeh harkat ki hai. Abraha ne usi waqt qasam kha li ke main Makkah pohanchoon ga aur Baitullah ki eent se eent baja doonga. Aur ek riwayat mein yun bhi hai ke chand milay julay naujawan Quraishiyon ne is girja mein aag laga di thi aur us waqt hawa bhi bohat tez thi, saara girja jal gaya aur munh ke bal zameen par gir gaya. Is par Abraha ne bohat bada lashkar saath le kar Makkah par charhai ki taake koi rok na sake aur apne saath ek bada ooncha aur mota hathi liya jisay Mahmood kaha jata tha.

Is jaisa hathi aur koi na tha. Shah-e-Habsha ne yeh hathi us ke paas isi garz se bheja tha. Aath ya barah hathi aur bhi sath thay. Yeh Ka'bay ke dhane ki niyat se chala, yeh soch kar ke Ka'bay ki deewaron mein mazboot zanjeerein daal doon ga aur hathiyon ki gardanon mein un zanjeeron ko baandh doon ga. Hathi ek hi jhatkay mein charon deewarein Baitullah ki jar se gira dein ge. Jab Ahl-e-Arab ko yeh khabrein maloom huin to un par bada bhari asar hua. Unhon ne musammam irada kar liya ke khwah kuch bhi ho hum zaroor is se muqabla karenge aur usay is ki is badkirdari se roken ge. Ek Yamani shareef sardar jo wahan ke badshahon ki aulad mein se tha jisay Zunafar kaha jata tha, yeh khada ho gaya, apni qoum ko aur kul aas paas ke Arab ko jama kiya aur is badniyat badshah se muqabla kiya, lekin qudrat ko kuch aur hi manzoor tha. Arabon ko shikast hui aur Zunafar is khabeeth ke hath mein qaid ho gaya. Us ne usay bhi sath liya aur Makkah Shareef ki taraf badha. Khath'am qabeelay ki zameen par jab yeh pohancha to yahan Nafeel bin Habeeb Khath'ami ne apne lashkaron se is ka muqabla kiya lekin Abraha ne unhein bhi maghloob kar liya aur Nafeel bhi qaid ho gaya. Pehle to is zalim ne usay qatl karna chaha lekin phir qatl na kiya aur qaid karke sath le liya taake rasta banaye. Jab Taif ke qareeb pohancha to qabeela Saqeef ne is se sulah kar li ke aisa na ho un ke but-khanon ko jis mein Laat nami but tha yeh tod de. Us ne bhi un ki badi aao-bhagat ki. Unhon ne Abu Righal ko is ke sath kar diya ke yeh tumhein wahan ka rasta bataye ga. Abraha jab Makkah ke bilkul qareeb Mu'ammis ke pohancha to us ne yahan padao kiya. Is ke lashkar ne aas paas Makkah walon ke jo janwar oont waghera char chug rahe thay sab ko apne qabzay mein kiya. In janwaron mein do sau oont to sirf Abdul Muttalib ke thay. Aswad bin Maqsood jo is ke lashkar ke harawal ka sardar tha, us ne Abraha ke hukum se in janwaron ko loota tha, jis par Arab shairon ne is ki hajo mein ashaar tasneef kiye hue hain jo Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein mojood hain. Ab Abraha ne apna qasid Hanata Hameeri Makkah walon ke paas bheja ke Makkah ke sab se bade sardar ko mere paas lao aur yeh bhi elaan kardo ke main Makkah walon se ladne nahin aaya, mera irada sirf Baitullah ko girane ka hai. Haan agar Makkah wale is ke bachane ke darpay hue to la-mahalah mujhe un se ladai karni padegi. Hanata jab Makkah mein aaya aur logon se mila jula to maloom hua ke yahan ka bada sardar Abdul Muttalib bin Hashim hai. Yeh Abdul Muttalib se mila aur shahi paigham pohanchaya jis ke jawab mein Abdul Muttalib ne kaha: Wallah na hamara irada is se ladne ka hai na hum mein itni taqat hai. Yeh Allah ka hurmat wala ghar hai, is ke Khaleel Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki zinda yaadgar hai. Allah agar chahe ga to apne ghar ki aap hifazat kare ga, warna hum mein to himmat-o-quwwat nahin.

Hanata ne kaha achha toh aap mere saath badshah ke paas chale chaliye. Abdul Muttalib saath hue, badshah ne jab unhein dekha toh haibat mein aa gaya. Abdul Muttalib gore chitte, sadol aur mazboot qawi wale haseen-o-jameel insaan thay, dekhte hi Abraha takht se neeche utar aaya aur farsh par Abdul Muttalib ke saath baith gaya aur apne tarjuman se kaha ki in se pooch ki kya chahta hai? Abdul Muttalib ne kaha mere do sau oont jo badshah ne le liye hain unhein wapas kar diya jaye. Badshah ne kaha in se keh de ki pehli nazar mein tera raub mujh par pada tha aur mere dil mein teri waqat baith gayi thi lekin pehle hi kalam mein tu ne sab kuch kho diya, apne do sau oont ki toh tujhe fikr hai aur apne aur apni qaum ke deen ki tujhe fikr nahin, main toh tum logon ka ibadat khana todne aur use khaak mein milane ke liye aaya hoon. Abdul Muttalib ne jawab diya ki sun badshah, oont toh mere hain is liye unhein bachane ki koshish mein main hoon aur Khana-e-Kaaba Allah ka hai, woh khud use bacha lega. Is par yeh sarkash kehne laga ki Allah bhi aaj use mere haath se nahin bacha sakta. Abdul Muttalib ne kaha behtar hai, woh jaane aur tu jaane. Yeh bhi marwi hai ki Makka ne tamam Hijaz ka tihai maal Abraha ko dena chaha ki woh apne is bad-irada se baaz aaye lekin us ne qabool na kiya. Khair, Abdul Muttalib toh apne oont lekar chal diye aur aakar Quraish ko hukum diya ki Makka bilkul khaali kar do, pahadon mein chale jao. Ab Abdul Muttalib apne saath Quraish ke chida-chida logon ko lekar Baitullah mein aaya aur Baitullah ke darwaze ka kunda thaam kar ro-ro kar aur gidgida-gidgida kar duayein maangni shuru keen ki Bari Ta'ala Abraha aur us ke khoon-khwar lashkar se apne paak aur zi-izzat ghar ko bacha le. Abdul Muttalib ne us waqt yeh duaiya ashaar padhe:

La humma innal mar'a yamna'u rahlahu famna' rihalak, la yaghlibanna salibuhum wa mahaluhum abadan mahalaka.

Ya'ni hum be-fikr hain, hum jaante hain ki har ghar wala apne ghar ka bachao aap karta hai, aye Allah! Tu bhi apne ghar ko apne dushmanon se bacha, yeh toh hargiz nahin ho sakta ki un ki saleeb aur un ki dolen teri dolon par ghalib aa jayein.

Ab Abdul Muttalib ne Baitullah ke darwaze ka kunda haath se chhor diya aur apne tamam sathiyon ko lekar aas paas ke paharon ki chotiyon par charh gaya. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke jaate hue qurbani ke sau oont Baitullah ke ird-gird nishan lagakar chhor diye the is niyat se ke agar yeh baddin aaye aur unhon ne Allah ke naam ki qurbani ke in janwaron ko chhera to azab-e-Ilahi un par utrega. Dusri subah Abraha ke lashkar mein Makkah jaane ki tayariyan hone lagin, apna khaas hathi jis ka naam Mahmood tha use tayar kiya, lashkar mein kamar-bandi ho chuki thi aur Makkah Sharif ki taraf munh utha kar chalne ki tayari ki. Is waqt Nafeel bin Habeeb jo us se raaste mein lara tha aur ab bator-e-qaidi ke us ke saath tha, woh aage barha aur shahi hathi ka kaan pakar liya aur kaha, "Mahmood baith ja aur jahan se aaya hai wahin khairiyat ke saath chala ja, tu Allah Ta'ala ke mohtaram shehar mein hai." Yeh keh kar kaan chhor diya aur bhaag kar qareeb ki pahari mein ja chupa. Mahmood hathi yeh sunte hi baith gaya, ab hazar jatan feelban kar rahe hain, lashkari bhi koshishein karte karte thak gaye lekin hathi apni jagah se hilta hi nahin, sar par ankush maar rahe hain, idhar udhar se bhale aur barchhe maar rahe hain, aankhon mein ankush daal rahe hain, garz tamam jatan kar liye lekin hathi jumbish bhi nahin karta. Phir bator-e-imtehan ke us ka munh Yaman ki taraf karke chalana chaha to jhat se khara ho kar dorta hua chal diya, Shaam ki taraf chalana chaha to bhi poori taqat se aage barh gaya, mashriq ki taraf le jana chaha to bhi bhaga bhaga gaya, phir Makkah Sharif ki taraf munh karke aage barhana chaha wahin baith gaya. Unhon ne phir use marna shuru kiya, dekha ke ek ghata-top parindon ka jhurmat badal ki tarah samundar ke kinare ki taraf se umda chala aa raha hai, abhi poori tarah dekh bhi nahin paye the ke woh janwar sar par aa gaye, charon taraf se saare lashkar ko gher liya aur un mein har ek ki chonch mein ek masar ya maash ke daane barabar kankari thi, aur dono panjon mein do do kankariyan thin. Yeh un par phenkne lage, jis par yeh kankari aan pari woh wahin halak ho gaya. Ab to is lashkar mein bhagdar par gayi, har ek Nafeel Nafeel karne laga kyunke use un logon ne apna rahbar aur raaste batane wala samajh rakha tha. Nafeel to hathi ko keh kar pahar par charh gaya aur deegar ahl-e-Makkah un logon ki yeh durgat apni aankhon se dekh rahe the aur Nafeel wahin khara yeh ashaar parh raha tha.

Ainal mafarr-u wal-ilahut-talib, wal-ashramul maghloob laisal ghalib. Ab jaye panah kahan hai? Jabke Allah khud taak mein lag gaya hai. Suno ashram badbakht maghloob ho gaya, ab yeh panapne ka nahin. Aur bhi Nufail ne is waqiye ke mutaliq bahut se ashaar kahe hain jin mein is waqiye ko bayan kiya hai aur kaha hai: Kash ke tu us waqt maujood hota jabke in hathi walon ki shamat aayi hai aur wadi-e-muhassab mein in par azab ke sangreze barse hain, to us waqt tu is Allah ke lashkar yani parindon ko dekh kar qatan sajde mein gir padta. Hum to wahan khade hamd-e-Rabb ki ragniyan alap rahe the, go kaleje hamare bhi unche ho gaye the ke kahin koi kankari hamara kaam bhi tamam na kar de. Nasrani munh mode bhag rahe the aur Nufail Nufail pukar rahe the. Goya ke Nufail par unke baap dadon ka koi qarz tha. Waqidi farmate hain yeh parinde zard rang ke the, kabootar se kuch chhote the, unke paon surkh the. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Mahmood hathi baith gaya aur puri koshish ke bawajood bhi na utha to unhon ne dusre hathi ko aage kiya, usne qadam badhaya hi tha ke uski peshani par kankari padi aur bilbila kar peeche hata aur phir aur hathi bhi bhag khade hue. Idhar barabar kankariyan aane lagin, aksar to wahin dher ho gaye aur baaz jo idhar udhar bhag nikle, un mein se koi jaanbar na hua. Bhagte bhagte unke aaza kat kar girte jate the aur bilakhir jaan se jate the. Abraha badshah bhi bhaga lekin ek ek uzw-e-badan jharna shuru hua, yahan tak ke Khusam ke shahron mein se Sana mein jab woh pahuncha to bilkul gosht ka lothra bana hua tha, wahin bilak bilak kar dam toda aur kutte ki maut mara, dil tak phat gaya. Quraishiyon ko bada maal hath laga, Abdul Muttalib ne to sone se ek kunwan pur kar liya tha. Zameen-e-Arab mein aabla aur chechak isi saal paida hote hue dekhe gaye aur isi tarah sapand aur hanzal waghera ke kadwe darakht bhi isi saal zameen-e-Arab mein dekhe gaye hain. Pas Allah Ta'ala bazuban-e-Rasool-e-Masoom (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni yeh nemat yaad dilata hai aur goya farmaya ja raha hai ke agar tum mere ghar ki isi tarah izzat-o-hurmat karte rehte aur mere Rasool ko mante to main bhi isi tarah tumhari hifazat karta aur tumhein dushmanon se nijat deta. Ababeel jama ka seegha hai, iska wahid lughat-e-Arab mein paya nahin gaya. Sijjeel ke ma'ani hain bahut hi sakht aur baaz mufassireen kehte hain ke yeh do Farsi lafzon se murakkab hai yani sang aur gil se, yani mitti aur patthar. Garz Sijjeel woh hai jis mein patthar ma'a mitti ke ho. Asf jama hai asfat ki, kheti ke un patton ko kehte hain jo pak na gaye hon.

Ababeel ke ma'ani hain garoh garoh, jhund, bahut saare, pai dar pai, jama shuda, idhar udhar se aane wale. Ba'az nahvi kehte hain is ka wahid abeel hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain in parindon ki chonch thi parindon jaisi aur panje kutton jaise. Ikrama farmate hain yeh sabz rang ke parind thay jo samundar se nikle thay, in ke sar darindon jaise thay. Aur aqwal bhi hain, yeh parind baqaida in lashkariyon ke saron par paray baandh kar kharay ho gaye aur phir cheekhne lage, phir patthar phenka, jis ke sar mein laga us ke neeche se nikal gaya aur do tukray ho kar zameen par gira, jis jis uzw par gira woh uzw saaqit ho gaya. Saath hi tez aandhi aayi jis se aur aas paas ke kankar bhi in ki aankhon mein ghus gaye aur sab teh-o-bala ho gaye. 'Asf' kehte hain chaaray ko aur kati kheti ko aur gehun ke darakht ke patton ko, aur 'ma'kool' se murad tukray tukray kiya hua hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke 'asf' kehte hain bhoosi ko jo anaaj ke daanon ke oopar hoti hai. Ibn Zaid farmate hain murad kheton ke woh patte hain jinhein jaanwar char chuke hon. Matlab yeh hai ke Allah ne in ko tehas nehas kar diya aur aam-o-khaas ko halak kar diya, is ki saari tadbeerein ulat ho gayin, koi bhalai unhein naseeb na hui, aisa bhi koi un par sahih saalim na raha jo ke in ki khabar pahunchaye. Jo bhi bacha woh zakhmi ho kar aur us zakhm se phir jaan bar na ho saka. Khud baadshah bhi go woh ek gosht ke lothray ki tarah ho gaya tha, joon toon Sana mein pahuncha lekin wahan jaate hi us ka kaleja phat gaya aur waqia bayaan kar hi chuka tha ke mar gaya. Is ke baad is ka larka yaksu Yaman ka baadshah bana, phir is ke dusre bhai Masroq bin Abraha ko saltanat mili. Ab Seeb bin Dhu-Yazan Humairi Kisra ke darbar mein pahuncha aur us se madad talab ki taake woh ahl-e-Habsha se lare aur Yaman in se khaali kara le. Kisra ne is ke saath ek lashkar-e-jarrar kar diya, is lashkar ne ahl-e-Habsha ko shikast di aur Abraha ke khandan se saltanat nikal gayi aur phir qabila Humair yahan ka baadshah ban gaya. Arabon ne is par bari khushi manayi aur charon taraf se mubarakbadiyan wasool huin.

Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Abraha ke lashkar ke feelban aur charkatay ko main ne Makkah Sharif mein dekha, dono andhay ho gaye thay, chal phir nahin saktay thay aur bheek manga kartay thay. Hazrat Asma bint-e-Abi Bakr (R.A) farmati hain, Isaf aur Naila buton ke paas yeh baithay rehtay thay jahan mushrikeen apni qurbaniyan kartay thay aur logon se bheek mangtay phirtay thay. Is feelban ka naam Anisa tha. Ba'az tareekhon mein yeh bhi hai ke Abraha khwah is charhai mein na tha balkay us ne apne lashkar ko ba-mat-huti Shams bin Maqsood ke bheja tha. Yeh lashkar bees hazar ka tha aur yeh parind un ke oopar raat ke waqt aaye thay aur subh tak un sab ka satya-nas ho chuka tha, lekin yeh riwayat bohat ghareeb hai aur sahih baat yeh hai ke khud Abraha Ashram Habshi hi apne sath lashkar le kar aaya tha. Yeh mumkin hai ke us ke har-awal ke dastay par yeh shakhs sardar ho. Is waqiye ko bohat se Arab shairon ne apne sheron mein bhi bast ke sath bayan kiya hai. Surah Fath ki tafsir mein hum is waqiye ko mufassal bayan kar aaye hain, jis mein hai ke jab Hudaibiyah walay din Rasool Allah (ﷺ) us teelay par charhay jahan se aap Quraishiyon par janay walay thay to aap ki oontni baith gayi. Logon ne usay danta-dipta lekin woh na uthi. Log kehnay lagay Qaswa thak gayi, aap ne farmaya yeh thaki nahin, is mein urnay ki aadat hai, isay us Allah ne rok liya hai jis ne hathiyon ko rok liya tha. Phir farmaya us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, Makkah walay jin sharait par mujh se sulah chahein ge main sab maan loon ga bashart-e-ke Allah ki hurmaton ki hatak is mein na ho. Phir aap ne usay danta to woh foran uth khari hui. Yeh hadith Sahih Bukhari Muslim ki hai aur ek hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Makkah par se hathiyon ko rok liya aur apne Nabi ko wahan ka qabza diya aur apne imandar bandon ko, suno aaj is ki hurmat waisi hi laut kar aa gayi hai jaisay kal thi, khabardar har hazir ko chahiye ke ghair-hazir ko pohancha de. Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Feel ki tafsir khatam hui.

Abraha aur us ka hashr: Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat ne Quraish par jo apni khaas ne'mat inaam farmayi thi us ka zikr kar raha hai ke jis lashkar ne haathiyon ko saath le kar Ka'be ko dhane ke liye charhayi ki thi Allah Ta'ala ne us se pehle ke woh Ka'be ke wajood ko mitayein un ka naam-o-nishan mita diya. Un ki tamam fareb-kariyan, un ki tamam quwwatein salb kar lein, barbaad-o-gharat kar diya. Yeh log mazhaban Nasrani thay lekin deen-e-Masih ko maskh kar diya tha, qareeban but-parast ho gaye thay. Unhein is tarah namuraad karna yeh goya pesh-e-khaima tha Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki be'sat ka aur ittila thi aap ki aamad-aamad ki. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isi saal tawallud huye, aksar tareekh-daan hazraat ka yahi qaul hai. Toh goya Rabb-ul-Aalameen farma raha hai ke aye Quraishiyo! Habsha ke is lashkar par tumhein fatah tumhari bhalayi ki wajah se nahin di gayi thi balkay is mein hamaray ghar ka bachaao tha jisay hum sharaf, buzurgi, azmat-o-izzat mein apnay Aakhir-uz-Zaman paighambar Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat se barhanay walay thay. Gharz Ashab-e-Feel ka mukhtasar waqea toh yeh hai jo bayan hua aur mutawwal waqea Ashab-e-Ukhdood ke bayan mein guzar chuka hai ke qabeela Humair ka aakhri badshah Zunawas jo mushrik tha jis ne apnay zamane ke musalmanon ko khayiyon mein qatl kiya tha jo sachay Nasrani thay aur tadaad mein taqreeban bees hazar thay, saaray ke saaray shaheed kar diye gaye thay sirf Daus Zu-Tha'laban ek bach gaya tha jo mulk-e-Shaam ja pohancha aur Qaisar-e-Room se faryad-rasi chahi. Yeh badshah Nasrani mazhab par tha, us ne Habsha ke badshah Najashi ko likha ke is ke saath apni poori fauj kar do is liye ke yahan se dushman ka mulk qareeb tha. Us badshah ne Arbaat aur Abu Yaksoom Abraha bin Sabah ko ameer-e-lashkar bana kar bahut bara lashkar de kar dono ko is ki sarkobi ke liye rawana kiya. Yeh lashkar Yaman pohancha aur Yaman ko aur Yamaniyon ko takht-o-taraj kar diya. Zunawas bhaag khara hua aur darya mein doob kar mar gaya aur un logon ki saltanat ka khatma ho gaya aur saaray Yaman par Shah-e-Habsha ka qabza ho gaya aur yeh dono sardar yahan rehnay sehnay lagay lekin kuch thori muddat ke baad un mein na-chaqi ho gayi. Aakhir naubat yahan tak pohanchi ke dono ne aamnay saamnay safein baandh lein aur larnay ke liye nikal aaye. Aam hamla honay se beshtar un dono sardaron ne aapas mein kaha ke faujon ko laranay aur logon ko qatl karanay ki kya zaroorat, aao hum tum dono maidan mein niklein aur ek dusray se lar kar faisla kar lein jo zinda bach jaye mulk-o-fauj us ki. Chunancha yeh baat tay ho gayi aur dono maidan mein nikal aaye. Arbaat ne Abraha par hamla kiya aur talwar ke ek hi waar se chehra khoon-o-khoon kar diya, naak, hont aur munh kat gaya. Abraha ke ghulam Atwada ne is mauqa par Arbaat par ek be-panah hamla kiya aur usay qatl kar diya. Abraha zakhmi ho kar maidan se zinda wapas gaya. Ilaaj-e-mualija se zakhm achay ho gaye aur Yaman ka yeh mustaqil badshah ban baitha.

Najashi Habsha ko jab yeh waqia maloom hua toh woh sakht gussa hua aur ek khat Abraha ko likha, usay bari lanat-malamat ki aur kaha ke qasam Allah ki main tere shehron ko pamal kar doonga aur teri choti kaat laoon ga. Abraha ne is ka jawab nihayat aajizi se likha aur qasid ko bohat saaray hadiye diye aur ek thaili mein Yaman ki mitti bhar di aur apni peshani ke baal kaat kar is mein rakh diye. Aur apne khat mein apne qasooron ki maafi talab ki aur likha ke yeh Yaman ki mitti hazir hai aur choti ke baal bhi, aap apni qasam poori kijiye aur narazgi maaf farmaiye. Is se Shah-e-Habsha khush ho gaya aur yahan ki sardari isi ke naam kar di. Ab Abraha ne Najashi ko likha ke main yahan Yaman mein aap ke liye ek aisa girja tameer kar raha hoon ke ab tak duniya mein aisa na bana ho aur is girja ghar ka banana shuru kiya baray ehtimam aur karr-o-farr se, bohat ooncha, bohat mazboot, behad khubsurat aur munaqqash-o-muzayyan girja banaya. Is qadar buland tha ke choti tak nazar daalne wale ki topi gir padti thi, isi liye Arab isay Qalees kehte yani topi phenk dene wala. Ab Abraha Ashram ko yeh soojhi ke log bajaye Ka'batullah ke hajj ke is ka hajj karein, apni saari mamlikat mein is ki munadi kara di. Adnaniya aur Qahtaniya Arab ko yeh bohat bura laga, udhar se Quraish bhi bharak uthay. Thore din mein koi shakhs raat ke waqt is ke andar ghus gaya aur wahan pakhana karke chala aaya. Chowkidar ne jab yeh dekha toh badshah ko khabar pohanchai aur kaha ke yeh kaam Quraishiyon ka hai, chunke aap ne un ka Ka'ba rok diya hai lehaza unhon ne josh aur ghazab mein aa kar yeh harkat ki hai. Abraha ne usi waqt qasam kha li ke main Makkah pohanchoon ga aur Baitullah ki eent se eent baja doonga. Aur ek riwayat mein yun bhi hai ke chand milay julay naujawan Quraishiyon ne is girja mein aag laga di thi aur us waqt hawa bhi bohat tez thi, saara girja jal gaya aur munh ke bal zameen par gir gaya. Is par Abraha ne bohat bada lashkar saath le kar Makkah par charhai ki taake koi rok na sake aur apne saath ek bada ooncha aur mota hathi liya jisay Mahmood kaha jata tha.

Is jaisa hathi aur koi na tha. Shah-e-Habsha ne yeh hathi us ke paas isi garz se bheja tha. Aath ya barah hathi aur bhi sath thay. Yeh Ka'bay ke dhane ki niyat se chala, yeh soch kar ke Ka'bay ki deewaron mein mazboot zanjeerein daal doon ga aur hathiyon ki gardanon mein un zanjeeron ko baandh doon ga. Hathi ek hi jhatkay mein charon deewarein Baitullah ki jar se gira dein ge. Jab Ahl-e-Arab ko yeh khabrein maloom huin to un par bada bhari asar hua. Unhon ne musammam irada kar liya ke khwah kuch bhi ho hum zaroor is se muqabla karenge aur usay is ki is badkirdari se roken ge. Ek Yamani shareef sardar jo wahan ke badshahon ki aulad mein se tha jisay Zunafar kaha jata tha, yeh khada ho gaya, apni qoum ko aur kul aas paas ke Arab ko jama kiya aur is badniyat badshah se muqabla kiya, lekin qudrat ko kuch aur hi manzoor tha. Arabon ko shikast hui aur Zunafar is khabeeth ke hath mein qaid ho gaya. Us ne usay bhi sath liya aur Makkah Shareef ki taraf badha. Khath'am qabeelay ki zameen par jab yeh pohancha to yahan Nafeel bin Habeeb Khath'ami ne apne lashkaron se is ka muqabla kiya lekin Abraha ne unhein bhi maghloob kar liya aur Nafeel bhi qaid ho gaya. Pehle to is zalim ne usay qatl karna chaha lekin phir qatl na kiya aur qaid karke sath le liya taake rasta banaye. Jab Taif ke qareeb pohancha to qabeela Saqeef ne is se sulah kar li ke aisa na ho un ke but-khanon ko jis mein Laat nami but tha yeh tod de. Us ne bhi un ki badi aao-bhagat ki. Unhon ne Abu Righal ko is ke sath kar diya ke yeh tumhein wahan ka rasta bataye ga. Abraha jab Makkah ke bilkul qareeb Mu'ammis ke pohancha to us ne yahan padao kiya. Is ke lashkar ne aas paas Makkah walon ke jo janwar oont waghera char chug rahe thay sab ko apne qabzay mein kiya. In janwaron mein do sau oont to sirf Abdul Muttalib ke thay. Aswad bin Maqsood jo is ke lashkar ke harawal ka sardar tha, us ne Abraha ke hukum se in janwaron ko loota tha, jis par Arab shairon ne is ki hajo mein ashaar tasneef kiye hue hain jo Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein mojood hain. Ab Abraha ne apna qasid Hanata Hameeri Makkah walon ke paas bheja ke Makkah ke sab se bade sardar ko mere paas lao aur yeh bhi elaan kardo ke main Makkah walon se ladne nahin aaya, mera irada sirf Baitullah ko girane ka hai. Haan agar Makkah wale is ke bachane ke darpay hue to la-mahalah mujhe un se ladai karni padegi. Hanata jab Makkah mein aaya aur logon se mila jula to maloom hua ke yahan ka bada sardar Abdul Muttalib bin Hashim hai. Yeh Abdul Muttalib se mila aur shahi paigham pohanchaya jis ke jawab mein Abdul Muttalib ne kaha: Wallah na hamara irada is se ladne ka hai na hum mein itni taqat hai. Yeh Allah ka hurmat wala ghar hai, is ke Khaleel Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki zinda yaadgar hai. Allah agar chahe ga to apne ghar ki aap hifazat kare ga, warna hum mein to himmat-o-quwwat nahin.

Hanata ne kaha achha toh aap mere saath badshah ke paas chale chaliye. Abdul Muttalib saath hue, badshah ne jab unhein dekha toh haibat mein aa gaya. Abdul Muttalib gore chitte, sadol aur mazboot qawi wale haseen-o-jameel insaan thay, dekhte hi Abraha takht se neeche utar aaya aur farsh par Abdul Muttalib ke saath baith gaya aur apne tarjuman se kaha ki in se pooch ki kya chahta hai? Abdul Muttalib ne kaha mere do sau oont jo badshah ne le liye hain unhein wapas kar diya jaye. Badshah ne kaha in se keh de ki pehli nazar mein tera raub mujh par pada tha aur mere dil mein teri waqat baith gayi thi lekin pehle hi kalam mein tu ne sab kuch kho diya, apne do sau oont ki toh tujhe fikr hai aur apne aur apni qaum ke deen ki tujhe fikr nahin, main toh tum logon ka ibadat khana todne aur use khaak mein milane ke liye aaya hoon. Abdul Muttalib ne jawab diya ki sun badshah, oont toh mere hain is liye unhein bachane ki koshish mein main hoon aur Khana-e-Kaaba Allah ka hai, woh khud use bacha lega. Is par yeh sarkash kehne laga ki Allah bhi aaj use mere haath se nahin bacha sakta. Abdul Muttalib ne kaha behtar hai, woh jaane aur tu jaane. Yeh bhi marwi hai ki Makka ne tamam Hijaz ka tihai maal Abraha ko dena chaha ki woh apne is bad-irada se baaz aaye lekin us ne qabool na kiya. Khair, Abdul Muttalib toh apne oont lekar chal diye aur aakar Quraish ko hukum diya ki Makka bilkul khaali kar do, pahadon mein chale jao. Ab Abdul Muttalib apne saath Quraish ke chida-chida logon ko lekar Baitullah mein aaya aur Baitullah ke darwaze ka kunda thaam kar ro-ro kar aur gidgida-gidgida kar duayein maangni shuru keen ki Bari Ta'ala Abraha aur us ke khoon-khwar lashkar se apne paak aur zi-izzat ghar ko bacha le. Abdul Muttalib ne us waqt yeh duaiya ashaar padhe:

La humma innal mar'a yamna'u rahlahu famna' rihalak, la yaghlibanna salibuhum wa mahaluhum abadan mahalaka.

Ya'ni hum be-fikr hain, hum jaante hain ki har ghar wala apne ghar ka bachao aap karta hai, aye Allah! Tu bhi apne ghar ko apne dushmanon se bacha, yeh toh hargiz nahin ho sakta ki un ki saleeb aur un ki dolen teri dolon par ghalib aa jayein.

Ab Abdul Muttalib ne Baitullah ke darwaze ka kunda haath se chhor diya aur apne tamam sathiyon ko lekar aas paas ke paharon ki chotiyon par charh gaya. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke jaate hue qurbani ke sau oont Baitullah ke ird-gird nishan lagakar chhor diye the is niyat se ke agar yeh baddin aaye aur unhon ne Allah ke naam ki qurbani ke in janwaron ko chhera to azab-e-Ilahi un par utrega. Dusri subah Abraha ke lashkar mein Makkah jaane ki tayariyan hone lagin, apna khaas hathi jis ka naam Mahmood tha use tayar kiya, lashkar mein kamar-bandi ho chuki thi aur Makkah Sharif ki taraf munh utha kar chalne ki tayari ki. Is waqt Nafeel bin Habeeb jo us se raaste mein lara tha aur ab bator-e-qaidi ke us ke saath tha, woh aage barha aur shahi hathi ka kaan pakar liya aur kaha, "Mahmood baith ja aur jahan se aaya hai wahin khairiyat ke saath chala ja, tu Allah Ta'ala ke mohtaram shehar mein hai." Yeh keh kar kaan chhor diya aur bhaag kar qareeb ki pahari mein ja chupa. Mahmood hathi yeh sunte hi baith gaya, ab hazar jatan feelban kar rahe hain, lashkari bhi koshishein karte karte thak gaye lekin hathi apni jagah se hilta hi nahin, sar par ankush maar rahe hain, idhar udhar se bhale aur barchhe maar rahe hain, aankhon mein ankush daal rahe hain, garz tamam jatan kar liye lekin hathi jumbish bhi nahin karta. Phir bator-e-imtehan ke us ka munh Yaman ki taraf karke chalana chaha to jhat se khara ho kar dorta hua chal diya, Shaam ki taraf chalana chaha to bhi poori taqat se aage barh gaya, mashriq ki taraf le jana chaha to bhi bhaga bhaga gaya, phir Makkah Sharif ki taraf munh karke aage barhana chaha wahin baith gaya. Unhon ne phir use marna shuru kiya, dekha ke ek ghata-top parindon ka jhurmat badal ki tarah samundar ke kinare ki taraf se umda chala aa raha hai, abhi poori tarah dekh bhi nahin paye the ke woh janwar sar par aa gaye, charon taraf se saare lashkar ko gher liya aur un mein har ek ki chonch mein ek masar ya maash ke daane barabar kankari thi, aur dono panjon mein do do kankariyan thin. Yeh un par phenkne lage, jis par yeh kankari aan pari woh wahin halak ho gaya. Ab to is lashkar mein bhagdar par gayi, har ek Nafeel Nafeel karne laga kyunke use un logon ne apna rahbar aur raaste batane wala samajh rakha tha. Nafeel to hathi ko keh kar pahar par charh gaya aur deegar ahl-e-Makkah un logon ki yeh durgat apni aankhon se dekh rahe the aur Nafeel wahin khara yeh ashaar parh raha tha.

Ainal mafarr-u wal-ilahut-talib, wal-ashramul maghloob laisal ghalib. Ab jaye panah kahan hai? Jabke Allah khud taak mein lag gaya hai. Suno ashram badbakht maghloob ho gaya, ab yeh panapne ka nahin. Aur bhi Nufail ne is waqiye ke mutaliq bahut se ashaar kahe hain jin mein is waqiye ko bayan kiya hai aur kaha hai: Kash ke tu us waqt maujood hota jabke in hathi walon ki shamat aayi hai aur wadi-e-muhassab mein in par azab ke sangreze barse hain, to us waqt tu is Allah ke lashkar yani parindon ko dekh kar qatan sajde mein gir padta. Hum to wahan khade hamd-e-Rabb ki ragniyan alap rahe the, go kaleje hamare bhi unche ho gaye the ke kahin koi kankari hamara kaam bhi tamam na kar de. Nasrani munh mode bhag rahe the aur Nufail Nufail pukar rahe the. Goya ke Nufail par unke baap dadon ka koi qarz tha. Waqidi farmate hain yeh parinde zard rang ke the, kabootar se kuch chhote the, unke paon surkh the. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Mahmood hathi baith gaya aur puri koshish ke bawajood bhi na utha to unhon ne dusre hathi ko aage kiya, usne qadam badhaya hi tha ke uski peshani par kankari padi aur bilbila kar peeche hata aur phir aur hathi bhi bhag khade hue. Idhar barabar kankariyan aane lagin, aksar to wahin dher ho gaye aur baaz jo idhar udhar bhag nikle, un mein se koi jaanbar na hua. Bhagte bhagte unke aaza kat kar girte jate the aur bilakhir jaan se jate the. Abraha badshah bhi bhaga lekin ek ek uzw-e-badan jharna shuru hua, yahan tak ke Khusam ke shahron mein se Sana mein jab woh pahuncha to bilkul gosht ka lothra bana hua tha, wahin bilak bilak kar dam toda aur kutte ki maut mara, dil tak phat gaya. Quraishiyon ko bada maal hath laga, Abdul Muttalib ne to sone se ek kunwan pur kar liya tha. Zameen-e-Arab mein aabla aur chechak isi saal paida hote hue dekhe gaye aur isi tarah sapand aur hanzal waghera ke kadwe darakht bhi isi saal zameen-e-Arab mein dekhe gaye hain. Pas Allah Ta'ala bazuban-e-Rasool-e-Masoom (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni yeh nemat yaad dilata hai aur goya farmaya ja raha hai ke agar tum mere ghar ki isi tarah izzat-o-hurmat karte rehte aur mere Rasool ko mante to main bhi isi tarah tumhari hifazat karta aur tumhein dushmanon se nijat deta. Ababeel jama ka seegha hai, iska wahid lughat-e-Arab mein paya nahin gaya. Sijjeel ke ma'ani hain bahut hi sakht aur baaz mufassireen kehte hain ke yeh do Farsi lafzon se murakkab hai yani sang aur gil se, yani mitti aur patthar. Garz Sijjeel woh hai jis mein patthar ma'a mitti ke ho. Asf jama hai asfat ki, kheti ke un patton ko kehte hain jo pak na gaye hon.

Ababeel ke ma'ani hain garoh garoh, jhund, bahut saare, pai dar pai, jama shuda, idhar udhar se aane wale. Ba'az nahvi kehte hain is ka wahid abeel hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain in parindon ki chonch thi parindon jaisi aur panje kutton jaise. Ikrama farmate hain yeh sabz rang ke parind thay jo samundar se nikle thay, in ke sar darindon jaise thay. Aur aqwal bhi hain, yeh parind baqaida in lashkariyon ke saron par paray baandh kar kharay ho gaye aur phir cheekhne lage, phir patthar phenka, jis ke sar mein laga us ke neeche se nikal gaya aur do tukray ho kar zameen par gira, jis jis uzw par gira woh uzw saaqit ho gaya. Saath hi tez aandhi aayi jis se aur aas paas ke kankar bhi in ki aankhon mein ghus gaye aur sab teh-o-bala ho gaye. 'Asf' kehte hain chaaray ko aur kati kheti ko aur gehun ke darakht ke patton ko, aur 'ma'kool' se murad tukray tukray kiya hua hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke 'asf' kehte hain bhoosi ko jo anaaj ke daanon ke oopar hoti hai. Ibn Zaid farmate hain murad kheton ke woh patte hain jinhein jaanwar char chuke hon. Matlab yeh hai ke Allah ne in ko tehas nehas kar diya aur aam-o-khaas ko halak kar diya, is ki saari tadbeerein ulat ho gayin, koi bhalai unhein naseeb na hui, aisa bhi koi un par sahih saalim na raha jo ke in ki khabar pahunchaye. Jo bhi bacha woh zakhmi ho kar aur us zakhm se phir jaan bar na ho saka. Khud baadshah bhi go woh ek gosht ke lothray ki tarah ho gaya tha, joon toon Sana mein pahuncha lekin wahan jaate hi us ka kaleja phat gaya aur waqia bayaan kar hi chuka tha ke mar gaya. Is ke baad is ka larka yaksu Yaman ka baadshah bana, phir is ke dusre bhai Masroq bin Abraha ko saltanat mili. Ab Seeb bin Dhu-Yazan Humairi Kisra ke darbar mein pahuncha aur us se madad talab ki taake woh ahl-e-Habsha se lare aur Yaman in se khaali kara le. Kisra ne is ke saath ek lashkar-e-jarrar kar diya, is lashkar ne ahl-e-Habsha ko shikast di aur Abraha ke khandan se saltanat nikal gayi aur phir qabila Humair yahan ka baadshah ban gaya. Arabon ne is par bari khushi manayi aur charon taraf se mubarakbadiyan wasool huin.

Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Abraha ke lashkar ke feelban aur charkatay ko main ne Makkah Sharif mein dekha, dono andhay ho gaye thay, chal phir nahin saktay thay aur bheek manga kartay thay. Hazrat Asma bint-e-Abi Bakr (R.A) farmati hain, Isaf aur Naila buton ke paas yeh baithay rehtay thay jahan mushrikeen apni qurbaniyan kartay thay aur logon se bheek mangtay phirtay thay. Is feelban ka naam Anisa tha. Ba'az tareekhon mein yeh bhi hai ke Abraha khwah is charhai mein na tha balkay us ne apne lashkar ko ba-mat-huti Shams bin Maqsood ke bheja tha. Yeh lashkar bees hazar ka tha aur yeh parind un ke oopar raat ke waqt aaye thay aur subh tak un sab ka satya-nas ho chuka tha, lekin yeh riwayat bohat ghareeb hai aur sahih baat yeh hai ke khud Abraha Ashram Habshi hi apne sath lashkar le kar aaya tha. Yeh mumkin hai ke us ke har-awal ke dastay par yeh shakhs sardar ho. Is waqiye ko bohat se Arab shairon ne apne sheron mein bhi bast ke sath bayan kiya hai. Surah Fath ki tafsir mein hum is waqiye ko mufassal bayan kar aaye hain, jis mein hai ke jab Hudaibiyah walay din Rasool Allah (ﷺ) us teelay par charhay jahan se aap Quraishiyon par janay walay thay to aap ki oontni baith gayi. Logon ne usay danta-dipta lekin woh na uthi. Log kehnay lagay Qaswa thak gayi, aap ne farmaya yeh thaki nahin, is mein urnay ki aadat hai, isay us Allah ne rok liya hai jis ne hathiyon ko rok liya tha. Phir farmaya us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, Makkah walay jin sharait par mujh se sulah chahein ge main sab maan loon ga bashart-e-ke Allah ki hurmaton ki hatak is mein na ho. Phir aap ne usay danta to woh foran uth khari hui. Yeh hadith Sahih Bukhari Muslim ki hai aur ek hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Makkah par se hathiyon ko rok liya aur apne Nabi ko wahan ka qabza diya aur apne imandar bandon ko, suno aaj is ki hurmat waisi hi laut kar aa gayi hai jaisay kal thi, khabardar har hazir ko chahiye ke ghair-hazir ko pohancha de. Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Feel ki tafsir khatam hui.

Abraha aur us ka hashr: Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat ne Quraish par jo apni khaas ne'mat inaam farmayi thi us ka zikr kar raha hai ke jis lashkar ne haathiyon ko saath le kar Ka'be ko dhane ke liye charhayi ki thi Allah Ta'ala ne us se pehle ke woh Ka'be ke wajood ko mitayein un ka naam-o-nishan mita diya. Un ki tamam fareb-kariyan, un ki tamam quwwatein salb kar lein, barbaad-o-gharat kar diya. Yeh log mazhaban Nasrani thay lekin deen-e-Masih ko maskh kar diya tha, qareeban but-parast ho gaye thay. Unhein is tarah namuraad karna yeh goya pesh-e-khaima tha Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki be'sat ka aur ittila thi aap ki aamad-aamad ki. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isi saal tawallud huye, aksar tareekh-daan hazraat ka yahi qaul hai. Toh goya Rabb-ul-Aalameen farma raha hai ke aye Quraishiyo! Habsha ke is lashkar par tumhein fatah tumhari bhalayi ki wajah se nahin di gayi thi balkay is mein hamaray ghar ka bachaao tha jisay hum sharaf, buzurgi, azmat-o-izzat mein apnay Aakhir-uz-Zaman paighambar Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat se barhanay walay thay. Gharz Ashab-e-Feel ka mukhtasar waqea toh yeh hai jo bayan hua aur mutawwal waqea Ashab-e-Ukhdood ke bayan mein guzar chuka hai ke qabeela Humair ka aakhri badshah Zunawas jo mushrik tha jis ne apnay zamane ke musalmanon ko khayiyon mein qatl kiya tha jo sachay Nasrani thay aur tadaad mein taqreeban bees hazar thay, saaray ke saaray shaheed kar diye gaye thay sirf Daus Zu-Tha'laban ek bach gaya tha jo mulk-e-Shaam ja pohancha aur Qaisar-e-Room se faryad-rasi chahi. Yeh badshah Nasrani mazhab par tha, us ne Habsha ke badshah Najashi ko likha ke is ke saath apni poori fauj kar do is liye ke yahan se dushman ka mulk qareeb tha. Us badshah ne Arbaat aur Abu Yaksoom Abraha bin Sabah ko ameer-e-lashkar bana kar bahut bara lashkar de kar dono ko is ki sarkobi ke liye rawana kiya. Yeh lashkar Yaman pohancha aur Yaman ko aur Yamaniyon ko takht-o-taraj kar diya. Zunawas bhaag khara hua aur darya mein doob kar mar gaya aur un logon ki saltanat ka khatma ho gaya aur saaray Yaman par Shah-e-Habsha ka qabza ho gaya aur yeh dono sardar yahan rehnay sehnay lagay lekin kuch thori muddat ke baad un mein na-chaqi ho gayi. Aakhir naubat yahan tak pohanchi ke dono ne aamnay saamnay safein baandh lein aur larnay ke liye nikal aaye. Aam hamla honay se beshtar un dono sardaron ne aapas mein kaha ke faujon ko laranay aur logon ko qatl karanay ki kya zaroorat, aao hum tum dono maidan mein niklein aur ek dusray se lar kar faisla kar lein jo zinda bach jaye mulk-o-fauj us ki. Chunancha yeh baat tay ho gayi aur dono maidan mein nikal aaye. Arbaat ne Abraha par hamla kiya aur talwar ke ek hi waar se chehra khoon-o-khoon kar diya, naak, hont aur munh kat gaya. Abraha ke ghulam Atwada ne is mauqa par Arbaat par ek be-panah hamla kiya aur usay qatl kar diya. Abraha zakhmi ho kar maidan se zinda wapas gaya. Ilaaj-e-mualija se zakhm achay ho gaye aur Yaman ka yeh mustaqil badshah ban baitha.

Najashi Habsha ko jab yeh waqia maloom hua toh woh sakht gussa hua aur ek khat Abraha ko likha, usay bari lanat-malamat ki aur kaha ke qasam Allah ki main tere shehron ko pamal kar doonga aur teri choti kaat laoon ga. Abraha ne is ka jawab nihayat aajizi se likha aur qasid ko bohat saaray hadiye diye aur ek thaili mein Yaman ki mitti bhar di aur apni peshani ke baal kaat kar is mein rakh diye. Aur apne khat mein apne qasooron ki maafi talab ki aur likha ke yeh Yaman ki mitti hazir hai aur choti ke baal bhi, aap apni qasam poori kijiye aur narazgi maaf farmaiye. Is se Shah-e-Habsha khush ho gaya aur yahan ki sardari isi ke naam kar di. Ab Abraha ne Najashi ko likha ke main yahan Yaman mein aap ke liye ek aisa girja tameer kar raha hoon ke ab tak duniya mein aisa na bana ho aur is girja ghar ka banana shuru kiya baray ehtimam aur karr-o-farr se, bohat ooncha, bohat mazboot, behad khubsurat aur munaqqash-o-muzayyan girja banaya. Is qadar buland tha ke choti tak nazar daalne wale ki topi gir padti thi, isi liye Arab isay Qalees kehte yani topi phenk dene wala. Ab Abraha Ashram ko yeh soojhi ke log bajaye Ka'batullah ke hajj ke is ka hajj karein, apni saari mamlikat mein is ki munadi kara di. Adnaniya aur Qahtaniya Arab ko yeh bohat bura laga, udhar se Quraish bhi bharak uthay. Thore din mein koi shakhs raat ke waqt is ke andar ghus gaya aur wahan pakhana karke chala aaya. Chowkidar ne jab yeh dekha toh badshah ko khabar pohanchai aur kaha ke yeh kaam Quraishiyon ka hai, chunke aap ne un ka Ka'ba rok diya hai lehaza unhon ne josh aur ghazab mein aa kar yeh harkat ki hai. Abraha ne usi waqt qasam kha li ke main Makkah pohanchoon ga aur Baitullah ki eent se eent baja doonga. Aur ek riwayat mein yun bhi hai ke chand milay julay naujawan Quraishiyon ne is girja mein aag laga di thi aur us waqt hawa bhi bohat tez thi, saara girja jal gaya aur munh ke bal zameen par gir gaya. Is par Abraha ne bohat bada lashkar saath le kar Makkah par charhai ki taake koi rok na sake aur apne saath ek bada ooncha aur mota hathi liya jisay Mahmood kaha jata tha.

Is jaisa hathi aur koi na tha. Shah-e-Habsha ne yeh hathi us ke paas isi garz se bheja tha. Aath ya barah hathi aur bhi sath thay. Yeh Ka'bay ke dhane ki niyat se chala, yeh soch kar ke Ka'bay ki deewaron mein mazboot zanjeerein daal doon ga aur hathiyon ki gardanon mein un zanjeeron ko baandh doon ga. Hathi ek hi jhatkay mein charon deewarein Baitullah ki jar se gira dein ge. Jab Ahl-e-Arab ko yeh khabrein maloom huin to un par bada bhari asar hua. Unhon ne musammam irada kar liya ke khwah kuch bhi ho hum zaroor is se muqabla karenge aur usay is ki is badkirdari se roken ge. Ek Yamani shareef sardar jo wahan ke badshahon ki aulad mein se tha jisay Zunafar kaha jata tha, yeh khada ho gaya, apni qoum ko aur kul aas paas ke Arab ko jama kiya aur is badniyat badshah se muqabla kiya, lekin qudrat ko kuch aur hi manzoor tha. Arabon ko shikast hui aur Zunafar is khabeeth ke hath mein qaid ho gaya. Us ne usay bhi sath liya aur Makkah Shareef ki taraf badha. Khath'am qabeelay ki zameen par jab yeh pohancha to yahan Nafeel bin Habeeb Khath'ami ne apne lashkaron se is ka muqabla kiya lekin Abraha ne unhein bhi maghloob kar liya aur Nafeel bhi qaid ho gaya. Pehle to is zalim ne usay qatl karna chaha lekin phir qatl na kiya aur qaid karke sath le liya taake rasta banaye. Jab Taif ke qareeb pohancha to qabeela Saqeef ne is se sulah kar li ke aisa na ho un ke but-khanon ko jis mein Laat nami but tha yeh tod de. Us ne bhi un ki badi aao-bhagat ki. Unhon ne Abu Righal ko is ke sath kar diya ke yeh tumhein wahan ka rasta bataye ga. Abraha jab Makkah ke bilkul qareeb Mu'ammis ke pohancha to us ne yahan padao kiya. Is ke lashkar ne aas paas Makkah walon ke jo janwar oont waghera char chug rahe thay sab ko apne qabzay mein kiya. In janwaron mein do sau oont to sirf Abdul Muttalib ke thay. Aswad bin Maqsood jo is ke lashkar ke harawal ka sardar tha, us ne Abraha ke hukum se in janwaron ko loota tha, jis par Arab shairon ne is ki hajo mein ashaar tasneef kiye hue hain jo Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein mojood hain. Ab Abraha ne apna qasid Hanata Hameeri Makkah walon ke paas bheja ke Makkah ke sab se bade sardar ko mere paas lao aur yeh bhi elaan kardo ke main Makkah walon se ladne nahin aaya, mera irada sirf Baitullah ko girane ka hai. Haan agar Makkah wale is ke bachane ke darpay hue to la-mahalah mujhe un se ladai karni padegi. Hanata jab Makkah mein aaya aur logon se mila jula to maloom hua ke yahan ka bada sardar Abdul Muttalib bin Hashim hai. Yeh Abdul Muttalib se mila aur shahi paigham pohanchaya jis ke jawab mein Abdul Muttalib ne kaha: Wallah na hamara irada is se ladne ka hai na hum mein itni taqat hai. Yeh Allah ka hurmat wala ghar hai, is ke Khaleel Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki zinda yaadgar hai. Allah agar chahe ga to apne ghar ki aap hifazat kare ga, warna hum mein to himmat-o-quwwat nahin.

Hanata ne kaha achha toh aap mere saath badshah ke paas chale chaliye. Abdul Muttalib saath hue, badshah ne jab unhein dekha toh haibat mein aa gaya. Abdul Muttalib gore chitte, sadol aur mazboot qawi wale haseen-o-jameel insaan thay, dekhte hi Abraha takht se neeche utar aaya aur farsh par Abdul Muttalib ke saath baith gaya aur apne tarjuman se kaha ki in se pooch ki kya chahta hai? Abdul Muttalib ne kaha mere do sau oont jo badshah ne le liye hain unhein wapas kar diya jaye. Badshah ne kaha in se keh de ki pehli nazar mein tera raub mujh par pada tha aur mere dil mein teri waqat baith gayi thi lekin pehle hi kalam mein tu ne sab kuch kho diya, apne do sau oont ki toh tujhe fikr hai aur apne aur apni qaum ke deen ki tujhe fikr nahin, main toh tum logon ka ibadat khana todne aur use khaak mein milane ke liye aaya hoon. Abdul Muttalib ne jawab diya ki sun badshah, oont toh mere hain is liye unhein bachane ki koshish mein main hoon aur Khana-e-Kaaba Allah ka hai, woh khud use bacha lega. Is par yeh sarkash kehne laga ki Allah bhi aaj use mere haath se nahin bacha sakta. Abdul Muttalib ne kaha behtar hai, woh jaane aur tu jaane. Yeh bhi marwi hai ki Makka ne tamam Hijaz ka tihai maal Abraha ko dena chaha ki woh apne is bad-irada se baaz aaye lekin us ne qabool na kiya. Khair, Abdul Muttalib toh apne oont lekar chal diye aur aakar Quraish ko hukum diya ki Makka bilkul khaali kar do, pahadon mein chale jao. Ab Abdul Muttalib apne saath Quraish ke chida-chida logon ko lekar Baitullah mein aaya aur Baitullah ke darwaze ka kunda thaam kar ro-ro kar aur gidgida-gidgida kar duayein maangni shuru keen ki Bari Ta'ala Abraha aur us ke khoon-khwar lashkar se apne paak aur zi-izzat ghar ko bacha le. Abdul Muttalib ne us waqt yeh duaiya ashaar padhe:

La humma innal mar'a yamna'u rahlahu famna' rihalak, la yaghlibanna salibuhum wa mahaluhum abadan mahalaka.

Ya'ni hum be-fikr hain, hum jaante hain ki har ghar wala apne ghar ka bachao aap karta hai, aye Allah! Tu bhi apne ghar ko apne dushmanon se bacha, yeh toh hargiz nahin ho sakta ki un ki saleeb aur un ki dolen teri dolon par ghalib aa jayein.

Ab Abdul Muttalib ne Baitullah ke darwaze ka kunda haath se chhor diya aur apne tamam sathiyon ko lekar aas paas ke paharon ki chotiyon par charh gaya. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke jaate hue qurbani ke sau oont Baitullah ke ird-gird nishan lagakar chhor diye the is niyat se ke agar yeh baddin aaye aur unhon ne Allah ke naam ki qurbani ke in janwaron ko chhera to azab-e-Ilahi un par utrega. Dusri subah Abraha ke lashkar mein Makkah jaane ki tayariyan hone lagin, apna khaas hathi jis ka naam Mahmood tha use tayar kiya, lashkar mein kamar-bandi ho chuki thi aur Makkah Sharif ki taraf munh utha kar chalne ki tayari ki. Is waqt Nafeel bin Habeeb jo us se raaste mein lara tha aur ab bator-e-qaidi ke us ke saath tha, woh aage barha aur shahi hathi ka kaan pakar liya aur kaha, "Mahmood baith ja aur jahan se aaya hai wahin khairiyat ke saath chala ja, tu Allah Ta'ala ke mohtaram shehar mein hai." Yeh keh kar kaan chhor diya aur bhaag kar qareeb ki pahari mein ja chupa. Mahmood hathi yeh sunte hi baith gaya, ab hazar jatan feelban kar rahe hain, lashkari bhi koshishein karte karte thak gaye lekin hathi apni jagah se hilta hi nahin, sar par ankush maar rahe hain, idhar udhar se bhale aur barchhe maar rahe hain, aankhon mein ankush daal rahe hain, garz tamam jatan kar liye lekin hathi jumbish bhi nahin karta. Phir bator-e-imtehan ke us ka munh Yaman ki taraf karke chalana chaha to jhat se khara ho kar dorta hua chal diya, Shaam ki taraf chalana chaha to bhi poori taqat se aage barh gaya, mashriq ki taraf le jana chaha to bhi bhaga bhaga gaya, phir Makkah Sharif ki taraf munh karke aage barhana chaha wahin baith gaya. Unhon ne phir use marna shuru kiya, dekha ke ek ghata-top parindon ka jhurmat badal ki tarah samundar ke kinare ki taraf se umda chala aa raha hai, abhi poori tarah dekh bhi nahin paye the ke woh janwar sar par aa gaye, charon taraf se saare lashkar ko gher liya aur un mein har ek ki chonch mein ek masar ya maash ke daane barabar kankari thi, aur dono panjon mein do do kankariyan thin. Yeh un par phenkne lage, jis par yeh kankari aan pari woh wahin halak ho gaya. Ab to is lashkar mein bhagdar par gayi, har ek Nafeel Nafeel karne laga kyunke use un logon ne apna rahbar aur raaste batane wala samajh rakha tha. Nafeel to hathi ko keh kar pahar par charh gaya aur deegar ahl-e-Makkah un logon ki yeh durgat apni aankhon se dekh rahe the aur Nafeel wahin khara yeh ashaar parh raha tha.

Ainal mafarr-u wal-ilahut-talib, wal-ashramul maghloob laisal ghalib. Ab jaye panah kahan hai? Jabke Allah khud taak mein lag gaya hai. Suno ashram badbakht maghloob ho gaya, ab yeh panapne ka nahin. Aur bhi Nufail ne is waqiye ke mutaliq bahut se ashaar kahe hain jin mein is waqiye ko bayan kiya hai aur kaha hai: Kash ke tu us waqt maujood hota jabke in hathi walon ki shamat aayi hai aur wadi-e-muhassab mein in par azab ke sangreze barse hain, to us waqt tu is Allah ke lashkar yani parindon ko dekh kar qatan sajde mein gir padta. Hum to wahan khade hamd-e-Rabb ki ragniyan alap rahe the, go kaleje hamare bhi unche ho gaye the ke kahin koi kankari hamara kaam bhi tamam na kar de. Nasrani munh mode bhag rahe the aur Nufail Nufail pukar rahe the. Goya ke Nufail par unke baap dadon ka koi qarz tha. Waqidi farmate hain yeh parinde zard rang ke the, kabootar se kuch chhote the, unke paon surkh the. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Mahmood hathi baith gaya aur puri koshish ke bawajood bhi na utha to unhon ne dusre hathi ko aage kiya, usne qadam badhaya hi tha ke uski peshani par kankari padi aur bilbila kar peeche hata aur phir aur hathi bhi bhag khade hue. Idhar barabar kankariyan aane lagin, aksar to wahin dher ho gaye aur baaz jo idhar udhar bhag nikle, un mein se koi jaanbar na hua. Bhagte bhagte unke aaza kat kar girte jate the aur bilakhir jaan se jate the. Abraha badshah bhi bhaga lekin ek ek uzw-e-badan jharna shuru hua, yahan tak ke Khusam ke shahron mein se Sana mein jab woh pahuncha to bilkul gosht ka lothra bana hua tha, wahin bilak bilak kar dam toda aur kutte ki maut mara, dil tak phat gaya. Quraishiyon ko bada maal hath laga, Abdul Muttalib ne to sone se ek kunwan pur kar liya tha. Zameen-e-Arab mein aabla aur chechak isi saal paida hote hue dekhe gaye aur isi tarah sapand aur hanzal waghera ke kadwe darakht bhi isi saal zameen-e-Arab mein dekhe gaye hain. Pas Allah Ta'ala bazuban-e-Rasool-e-Masoom (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni yeh nemat yaad dilata hai aur goya farmaya ja raha hai ke agar tum mere ghar ki isi tarah izzat-o-hurmat karte rehte aur mere Rasool ko mante to main bhi isi tarah tumhari hifazat karta aur tumhein dushmanon se nijat deta. Ababeel jama ka seegha hai, iska wahid lughat-e-Arab mein paya nahin gaya. Sijjeel ke ma'ani hain bahut hi sakht aur baaz mufassireen kehte hain ke yeh do Farsi lafzon se murakkab hai yani sang aur gil se, yani mitti aur patthar. Garz Sijjeel woh hai jis mein patthar ma'a mitti ke ho. Asf jama hai asfat ki, kheti ke un patton ko kehte hain jo pak na gaye hon.

Ababeel ke ma'ani hain garoh garoh, jhund, bahut saare, pai dar pai, jama shuda, idhar udhar se aane wale. Ba'az nahvi kehte hain is ka wahid abeel hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain in parindon ki chonch thi parindon jaisi aur panje kutton jaise. Ikrama farmate hain yeh sabz rang ke parind thay jo samundar se nikle thay, in ke sar darindon jaise thay. Aur aqwal bhi hain, yeh parind baqaida in lashkariyon ke saron par paray baandh kar kharay ho gaye aur phir cheekhne lage, phir patthar phenka, jis ke sar mein laga us ke neeche se nikal gaya aur do tukray ho kar zameen par gira, jis jis uzw par gira woh uzw saaqit ho gaya. Saath hi tez aandhi aayi jis se aur aas paas ke kankar bhi in ki aankhon mein ghus gaye aur sab teh-o-bala ho gaye. 'Asf' kehte hain chaaray ko aur kati kheti ko aur gehun ke darakht ke patton ko, aur 'ma'kool' se murad tukray tukray kiya hua hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke 'asf' kehte hain bhoosi ko jo anaaj ke daanon ke oopar hoti hai. Ibn Zaid farmate hain murad kheton ke woh patte hain jinhein jaanwar char chuke hon. Matlab yeh hai ke Allah ne in ko tehas nehas kar diya aur aam-o-khaas ko halak kar diya, is ki saari tadbeerein ulat ho gayin, koi bhalai unhein naseeb na hui, aisa bhi koi un par sahih saalim na raha jo ke in ki khabar pahunchaye. Jo bhi bacha woh zakhmi ho kar aur us zakhm se phir jaan bar na ho saka. Khud baadshah bhi go woh ek gosht ke lothray ki tarah ho gaya tha, joon toon Sana mein pahuncha lekin wahan jaate hi us ka kaleja phat gaya aur waqia bayaan kar hi chuka tha ke mar gaya. Is ke baad is ka larka yaksu Yaman ka baadshah bana, phir is ke dusre bhai Masroq bin Abraha ko saltanat mili. Ab Seeb bin Dhu-Yazan Humairi Kisra ke darbar mein pahuncha aur us se madad talab ki taake woh ahl-e-Habsha se lare aur Yaman in se khaali kara le. Kisra ne is ke saath ek lashkar-e-jarrar kar diya, is lashkar ne ahl-e-Habsha ko shikast di aur Abraha ke khandan se saltanat nikal gayi aur phir qabila Humair yahan ka baadshah ban gaya. Arabon ne is par bari khushi manayi aur charon taraf se mubarakbadiyan wasool huin.

Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Abraha ke lashkar ke feelban aur charkatay ko main ne Makkah Sharif mein dekha, dono andhay ho gaye thay, chal phir nahin saktay thay aur bheek manga kartay thay. Hazrat Asma bint-e-Abi Bakr (R.A) farmati hain, Isaf aur Naila buton ke paas yeh baithay rehtay thay jahan mushrikeen apni qurbaniyan kartay thay aur logon se bheek mangtay phirtay thay. Is feelban ka naam Anisa tha. Ba'az tareekhon mein yeh bhi hai ke Abraha khwah is charhai mein na tha balkay us ne apne lashkar ko ba-mat-huti Shams bin Maqsood ke bheja tha. Yeh lashkar bees hazar ka tha aur yeh parind un ke oopar raat ke waqt aaye thay aur subh tak un sab ka satya-nas ho chuka tha, lekin yeh riwayat bohat ghareeb hai aur sahih baat yeh hai ke khud Abraha Ashram Habshi hi apne sath lashkar le kar aaya tha. Yeh mumkin hai ke us ke har-awal ke dastay par yeh shakhs sardar ho. Is waqiye ko bohat se Arab shairon ne apne sheron mein bhi bast ke sath bayan kiya hai. Surah Fath ki tafsir mein hum is waqiye ko mufassal bayan kar aaye hain, jis mein hai ke jab Hudaibiyah walay din Rasool Allah (ﷺ) us teelay par charhay jahan se aap Quraishiyon par janay walay thay to aap ki oontni baith gayi. Logon ne usay danta-dipta lekin woh na uthi. Log kehnay lagay Qaswa thak gayi, aap ne farmaya yeh thaki nahin, is mein urnay ki aadat hai, isay us Allah ne rok liya hai jis ne hathiyon ko rok liya tha. Phir farmaya us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, Makkah walay jin sharait par mujh se sulah chahein ge main sab maan loon ga bashart-e-ke Allah ki hurmaton ki hatak is mein na ho. Phir aap ne usay danta to woh foran uth khari hui. Yeh hadith Sahih Bukhari Muslim ki hai aur ek hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Makkah par se hathiyon ko rok liya aur apne Nabi ko wahan ka qabza diya aur apne imandar bandon ko, suno aaj is ki hurmat waisi hi laut kar aa gayi hai jaisay kal thi, khabardar har hazir ko chahiye ke ghair-hazir ko pohancha de. Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Feel ki tafsir khatam hui.
